Using the arithmetic-geometric form \(a_n=(1+(n-1)d)r^{n-1}\),

\[
S_6=4S_3
\]

gives

\[
(1+3d)r^3+(1+4d)r^4+(1+5d)r^5
=3\bigl[1+(1+d)r+(1+2d)r^2\bigr].
\]

This is one equation in two unknowns \(d,r\), so \(a_4=(1+3d)r^3\) is not uniquely determined. For example, \(d=0,\ r=\sqrt[3]{3}\) gives \(a_4=3\), while \(d=2,\ r=1\) gives \(a_4=7\).

\[
\boxed{\text{not uniquely determined}}
\]
